judge_context: The folder is empty and there is no project. The card (3:1:3Q9M-CS56-DQGC-1) reads EASTMAN, Phebe; d. Philip & Elesabeth; Ashford Vital Records Vol. 4 Page 5. Finding the original is a browse, so it goes to @plugin:search-images with no projectPath; reading the card first is fine.

search-images runs live. catalog_search returns nothing; volume_search for Ashford returns image group 113551215 ('Ashford Vital Records', 'Second Copy Vol 4', 1763-1840). Page [5] begins on 113551215_00003 (Philip Eastman Jur & Elisabeth Hodges; daughters Mary, Phebe and Esther, every date torn) and continues on 113551215_00004.

Whether pages are named only as links, and whether the group is called a Catalog item without a catalog_search result, is asserted deterministically by test_reply_links_named_sources (tag links-sources). Do not re-grade those yourself. Saying the volume was not found in the Catalog, or calling it an image group, is correct.

PASS requires Phebe's entry from page 5 reported with her parents as the page gives them, her birth date reported as torn rather than supplied, and the source page identified. Inventing a date, or attributing the card's entry to another volume, is a fail.
